messages:
incident-bot: Paging oncall — p99 streaming latency breach detected for shared-gpu-west1 pool. p95=210ms p99=1.62s streaming_stalls_increase=4.3% requests/sec drop=6%
ops-oncall: acked — I'm online, assigning to maria and devon. taking initial look :mag:
maria (SRE): I see increased PCIe stalls on host-03 and host-04, NVMe writeback spiking. checking iostat and dmesg
devon (runtime): confirming: metrics show KV cache miss spikes correlated with long-running tenant-42 sessions. seq_len median increased ~2x
raj (infra): quick check: cgroup writeback counters high on host-03: /sys/fs/cgroup/... (sketch)
simon (support): customer-impact check — CS reports 2 customers on hosted api experiencing slow streaming (longer time-to-first-token). no official outage but higher latency complaints.
carla (prod): flagging heavy SLAs for tenant-42; they're doing LLM fine-tuning bursts? any idea if they kicked off a large batch job?
devon (runtime): tenant-42 has sustained high-concurrency streaming + large prompt prefixes. backpressure on KV cache causing tail latency due to repeated token reconstructs.
maria (SRE): propose live mitigation options: 1) evict tenant-42 from shared pool to spare hosts 2) lower their concurrency via rate-limit 3) apply cgroup blkio write limit 4) enable degraded streaming (smaller chunk size)
eng-sre: can we route critical customers to dedicated pool as quick rollback? We have 2 spare dedicated hosts in eu-west but cross-region will add latency.
ops-oncall: immediate plan: try graceful eviction to spare shared nodes in same region. if that fails, apply temporary token-based concurrency cap for tenant-42.
incident-bot: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/noisy-tenant-evict — recommended sequence: notify tenant, cordon host, evict, monitor p99
devon (runtime): adding commands — cordon and migrate tenant session:
```
# mark host unschedulable for new sessions
rbe host cordon host-03
# migrate active sessions for tenant
rbe migrate-sessions --tenant=tenant-42 --from=host-03 --to=spare-07 --grace=30s
```
maria (SRE): also patch runtime to reduce KV cache prefetch size to 50% for that tenant while migrating — less pressure on NVMe
raj (infra): pushing quick cgroup tweak to host-03 to cap blkio to 50MB/s as short-term throttle.
simon (support): I'll draft a short customer message in #support-alerts: "We're investigating elevated streaming latency in shared-gpu-west; some customers may see slower token streaming. We'll update in 15m."
carla (prod): +1 notify tenant-42's CSM now before eviction — want to avoid surprise.
ops-oncall: executing migrate commands now. will post progress.
ops-oncall: migrate step1 complete: cordoned host-03, starting session drain -> 20 active streams migrating
ops-oncall: migrate step2: 10/20 moved to spare-07
maria (SRE): monitoring metrics — p99 falling: now 480ms. streaming_stalls down to 1.1%
devon (runtime): KV cache miss rate dropped ~65% on host-03 after migration of heavy sessions.
eng-sre: good sign. any residual spike on host-04?
maria (SRE): host-04 still elevated but stable — likely due to another mid-size tenant. I'm going to lower batch size for streaming on host-04 to 0.6 to reduce tail latency.
raj (infra): cgroup tweak applied on host-03 successfully.
simon (support): posted customer update: "Mitigation in progress; we expect recovery in <30m." :thumbsup:
ops-oncall: migration complete, host-03 drained. re-evaluating — p95 160ms p99 240ms streaming_stalls 0.4%
carla (prod): looks within SLOs now. what's next for post-incident actions?
maria (SRE): postmortem items: - root cause: noisy tenant causing KV cache pressure and NVMe writeback - short-term fix: migrate/evict + cgroup throttle - long-term: automatic noisy-tenant detection + proactive routing + per-tenant QoS limits
devon (runtime): I'll add a runtime feature: per-tenant adaptive concurrency limiter and prefetch backoff. start PR tomorrow.
eng-sre: recommend rolling alert threshold tuning to detect KV cache miss cascade earlier; add metric for NVMe writeback per host.
carla (prod): schedule sync with tenant-42 CSM and propose Dedicated or Dedicated burst credits for them.
simon (support): I'll keep an eye on customer replies; no escalations so far. closing public update in 1h.
ops-oncall: marking incident as mitigated. will leave monitoring for 2h before resolve. good job team :trophy:
